summary: Tutorial: enable the Niagara Fluids plugin, create a Grid3D_Gas_Explosion system, make a sphere collide via the 'collider' actor tag, tune Override Parameters (resolution, world size), and adjust dissipation, buoyancy and render density/temperature in the Emitter Summary.
